title: Goal environment registry
description: contracts/env.yaml: every environment variable a Goal process reads, by name and meaning. It never holds a value: no default, example or secret. tools/envcheck (task env:check) checks it against the code and generates docs/reference/environment.md from it.

name.description: The variable's name, as the process reads it.

class.description: public: may be shown to anyone who uses the platform; config: a setting of the install, not a secret; secret: a credential.

required.description: true when a process that reads it refuses to start without it.

meaning.description: One line: what the variable sets.

indirect.description: For a name read by a key computed at run time: the file that names it, quoted. The variable counts as read while its name appears there.
